title: Characterize Qwen3.5 hybrid-cache compatibility
description: Qwen3.5-2B uses a hybrid cache with recurrent linear-attention state on most layers, so arbitrary token-block KV concatenation is not valid end to end. Explore compatible boundaries or restrict the method.
acceptance_criteria: Either demonstrate a correct hybrid-cache insertion mechanism or document a defensible architectural restriction.

title: Test page-conditioned carrier-state accumulation
description: Stream cold KV pages through one persistent decode. After each page-conditioned step, remove only the flashed page while retaining the appended token KV so page effects can accumulate across arbitrary-hop questions without page selection or an oracle.
acceptance_criteria: On synthetic multi-hop tasks with unknown hop count at runtime, compare poisoned/state-carrying decode against clean-carrier, no-page, and ablation controls; report final-answer accuracy and order sensitivity using the RTX 2070 SUPER.
notes: Implemented the intended poisoned carrier: each response token is processed with a page present, the page span is removed, and the newly appended page-conditioned KV is retained. Clean control recomputes the same committed placeholder without the page. Added direct depth-1 calibration and depth-2 relational tasks, normal full-prefill and all-independent-page controls, sentinel/forced/warmup modes, carrier widths 1 and 8, hot/original positions, 4/12 pages, and 1-3 passes. Across four unique canonical tasks: no-page 0/4, normal full prefill 4/4, all independent flashes 1/4, poisoned carrier 0/4, clean carrier 0/4. No configuration improved over clean. Surgery is real: answer-bearing Rowan/saffron page changed retained token KV by max 6.27734 and mean 0.13014 versus no-page, yet later answer remained wrong. Conclusion: untrained period-token KV residue is a measurable perturbation but not a behaviorally useful memory channel on Qwen3-1.7B. Full traces outputs/phase3 and aggregate/log committed with protocol-debug runs labeled separately.
close_reason: Experiment completed: state-carrying cache surgery verified, but poisoned carrier accuracy was 0/4 and never exceeded clean control across the tested direct and two-hop configurations.

title: Test query-conditioned latent page capsules
description: For each reusable cold page, process the ordinary query prefix against that page, retain only a fixed-width tail of query-token KV as a latent query-conditioned capsule, discard raw page KV, concatenate all capsules, then refresh the query once over the compact capsule bank and decode normally.
acceptance_criteria: Compare capsule widths on direct and multi-hop tasks, including 12-page scale; report accuracy, online latency, compact cache size, and controls. Runtime must use no answer/relevance labels and generate no per-page text.
notes: Completed Phase 7 with widths 4, 8, and 16. All two-hop trials failed; a direct one-page width-8 control also failed while ordinary full prefill answered correctly. The inference-only latent capsule does not retain a usable fact after source-page removal on Qwen3-1.7B. Artifacts: outputs/phase7.
close_reason: Implemented and tested with direct, multi-hop, width, and full-prefill controls; result is negative and documented.

title: Develop answer-free query-conditioned block selector
description: Find a selection signal that can choose a useful flashed KV block without access to the known answer. First test self-proposed continuation likelihood gain against the no-block baseline.
acceptance_criteria: On held-out randomized tasks, the selector ranks answer-bearing blocks above chance and improves end-to-end answer accuracy over no-flash and random-flash baselines.
notes: Literal period sentinel rejected: strict gates false-broke on formatting/explanations, permissive gates passed every page, and relevant-first control still emitted '.' with probability 0.99962 even though ordinary answer decoding from that page was correct. A direct YES/NO relevance probe also showed severe acquiescence bias and selected a distractor. Successful pivot: flash each page under an answer-free provenance task, have the model copy the page's own key, normalize case/punctuation externally, and compare with the query key. Exploratory normalized trials selected the unique relevant page and recovered the answer in 3/3. After freezing normalization, four fresh trials across historical person, book quote, treaty place, and valve pressure achieved unique relevant selection 4/4, baseline answer 0/4, selected-cache answer 4/4. Broad passive confidence/entropy/margin/prefix telemetry is recorded but not promoted as a selector. Full traces and aggregate are in outputs/phase2; EXPERIMENT_LOG.md distinguishes exploratory from post-freeze results.
close_reason: Acceptance met on four post-freeze held-out randomized tasks: unique relevant-page selection 4/4 and end-to-end answer accuracy 4/4 versus no-flash 0/4; exploratory normalized total 7/7.

title: Persist and benchmark cold source/KV pages outside GPU memory
description: Add a disk or CPU-RAM cold store with metadata and measured transfer costs; current experiment keeps candidate blocks in GPU memory only.
acceptance_criteria: Blocks can be saved, restored, inserted exactly, and benchmarked for latency and memory use on the RTX 2070 SUPER.
notes: The leading iterative token-sidecar controller no longer requires cold-page KV, but it does require fetching and prefilling one selected source page per hop. Extend this issue to benchmark disk/CPU source-token residency, optional KV residency for attention selectors, host-to-device transfer, eviction, and matched generated-token throughput at 1k+ pages.

title: Test model-generated semantic carrier tokens
description: Replace period-only carriers with short model-generated factual scratchpad fragments under each flashed page. Retain page-conditioned fragment KV, then replay the exact same fragment token IDs without pages to isolate hidden-KV benefit from visible semantic text.
acceptance_criteria: On direct and multi-hop shuffled corpora, report final-answer accuracy for semantic poisoned carrier, exact clean token replay, no-page, normal full-prefill, and all-independent-page controls without relevance-based generation decisions.
notes: Implemented sequential and isolated page-note selection with exact clean token replay. RTX 2070S results: sequential 1/3; six primary isolated trials: no-page 0/6, full prefill 6/6, all independent pages 1/6, poisoned 4/6, exact clean replay 5/6. Hidden page-conditioned state was never uniquely helpful and hurt the dumplings trial. Traces in outputs/phase4 and interpretation in EXPERIMENT_LOG.md.
close_reason: Completed semantic carrier implementation, exact-token replay control, direct/two-hop/three-hop and 4/6/12-page RTX 2070S trials, aggregate, and experiment log.

title: Test uninterrupted rotating-page free decode
description: Run one continuous free-form decode while rotating flashed cold pages token-by-token or in short fixed windows. Retain each processed token's page-conditioned KV after removing the page. No per-page summaries, markers, resets, relevance selection, answer oracle, or known hop count.
acceptance_criteria: Report direct, two-hop, and three-hop final-answer accuracy for poisoned continuous decode versus exact visible-token clean replay, no-page, normal full-prefill, and all-independent-page controls on the RTX 2070 SUPER; test at least per-token and short-window rotation.
notes: Implemented uninterrupted free decode with deterministic per-token/fixed-window page rotation, no summaries/markers/resets/gates/oracle, and exact token replay. On five primary ordinary-prompt window-8 trials: no-page 0/5, full prefill 5/5, all independent pages 2/5, poisoned 1/5, exact replay 1/5. Only direct relevant-first succeeded; direct relevant-last and all 3 multi-hop trials failed. Ordinary per-token direct also failed by blending values. Hidden KV was never uniquely beneficial. Traces in outputs/phase5 and write-up in EXPERIMENT_LOG.md.
close_reason: Completed uninterrupted rotating-page implementation, exact-replay controls, per-token and short-window RTX 2070S trials through three-hop tasks, verified aggregate, and experiment log.

title: Test query-attention cold-page shortlisting
close_reason: Duplicate of FlashCache-vhi; completed under that issue.

title: Build and validate answer-free iterative cold-page navigation
description: Use a compact cold-page sidecar plus model-written unknown-depth query carriers to select and exactly replay one page at a time without answer labels, relevant IDs, or hop counts.
acceptance_criteria: Test 128-page archives across depths one through four and multiple answer domains; compare no-page and full-prefill controls; report ordered-hop accuracy, online latency, sidecar build/scan time, and failure modes.
notes: Completed. Final preference regression 12/12 with all 30 hops in order; disjoint post-freeze history/quotation/place pool 10/12 with exact ordered paths on 10/12. No-page 0/12 on both. Mixed-domain sidecar build 2.29 ms, lookup 0.145 ms/hop, iterative mean 751 ms vs full-prefill 2118 ms. Working mechanism uses token-ID retrieval and exact source replay; it is not hidden-KV composition. Artifacts: outputs/phase12–15.
close_reason: Implemented, validated on frozen and disjoint post-freeze suites, documented, and retained with full JSON traces.

title: Validate exact Qwen3-1.7B KV cache surgery
description: Establish that the dense-attention target supports token-addressable KV slicing, concatenation, clone/restore, and cached continuation equivalence.
acceptance_criteria: All layers are token-addressable; split/reassembly is tensor-exact; restored branches reproduce logits exactly.
close_reason: Completed: Qwen3-1.7B has 28/28 dense token-addressable layers; exact split/reassembly and clone/restore reports are saved under outputs/phase0.

title: Test query refresh over concatenated cold KV
description: Concatenate independently precomputed cold page KV, discard stale no-page query KV, and recompute only the short recent query prefix once against all pages before normal decode. Measure correctness and latency versus no-page, stale-query all-page insertion, and full prefill. If needed, test a small fixed consolidation prefix.
acceptance_criteria: On direct, two-hop, three-hop, and 12-page tasks, report query-refresh accuracy and latency using original-position cold pages on the RTX 2070 SUPER; demonstrate whether the refreshed-query path improves over stale-query all-page insertion without re-encoding archive pages.
notes: Query refresh tested on direct, 4-page two-hop, 6-page three-hop, and 12-page two-hop tasks. Query refresh 0/4, stale all-page 0/4, full prefill 4/4. Online query tokens were only 16-20 but independent raw page KV still caused entity/value misbinding. Moving to query-conditioned latent capsules.
close_reason: Completed representative correctness and latency trials; query-only refresh did not improve accuracy over stale all-page insertion.

title: Separate useful perturbation from maximum output divergence
description: Investigate why mean JS/KL divergence ranks the answer-bearing block last even when that block alone fixes the answer. Compare answer-free usefulness signals.
acceptance_criteria: Document at least one answer-free metric that outperforms raw maximum divergence across multiple randomized tasks, or characterize the failure with aggregate evidence.
notes:
User-proposed leading hypothesis: reverse raw JS and rank by 1-JS (equivalently ascending JS). Test on additional held-out shuffles before adding a more elaborate selector.
Seven chat/hot-slot trials across four target values: inverse-JS top-1 recall 1/7, top-2 recall 6/7, but the 337-psi target ranked 12/12 inverse and 1/12 raw. Neither polarity consistently selects semantic relevance; aggregate saved in outputs/phase1/inverse_js_aggregate.json.
close_reason: Characterized with aggregate evidence: raw and inverse JS both fail as standalone selectors, with polarity flipping by target token geometry. Relevant flashing still fixed answer correctness in 7/7 trials.

title: Broaden needle tasks and report aggregate retrieval/correctness metrics
description: Generate multiple target identifiers, answers, distractor assignments, prompt paraphrases, and seeds rather than repeating one valve target.
acceptance_criteria: Report confidence intervals for answer accuracy, relevant-block MRR/recall, and gains over no-flash and random-flash baselines.
notes:
Added fictional history-person, book-quote speaker, and history-place task families with categorical answer scoring. First GPU matrix will use a 24-token fixed trajectory to include answer-region effects.
Six categorical trials across fictional history-person, book-quote speaker, and treaty-location families. Baseline 0/6, relevant flash 6/6, random single flash 6/72. Raw JS ranks 8,10,4,8,8,1; inverse ranks 5,3,9,5,5,12. Two-tail depth-2 recall only 1/6. Aggregate saved in outputs/phase1/diverse_task_aggregate.json.
Extended evaluation to 128-page one- through four-hop archives with personal preferences, historical speakers, literary quotation speakers, and treaty locations. Frozen-controller regression: preference 12/12 vs no-page 0/12. Disjoint post-freeze mixed-domain pool: iterative 10/12 vs no-page 0/12 and fixed-horizon full-prefill 8/12 strict; family breakdown history 4/4, place 4/4, quotations 2/4. Exact ordered-hop coverage 10/12. Results in outputs/phase15 and EXPERIMENT_LOG.md.
close_reason: Task families and aggregate correctness/retrieval metrics now cover numeric, names, quotations, locations, 128-page scale, and unknown depths one through four.

title: Demonstrate late single-block KV insertion improves answer correctness
description: Run an exhaustive synthetic needle test where each cold block is inserted after recent-context prefill, without recomputing the recent KV.
acceptance_criteria: The relevant block changes the free-generated numeric answer from incorrect to correct, while all distractor insertions remain incorrect.
close_reason: Completed: exhaustive hot-slot chat probe saved under outputs/phase1; baseline answered 125 psi, relevant insertion answered 413 psi, and all distractors were incorrect.

title: Evaluate iterative navigation on natural multi-document chains
description: Replace synthetic key-value notes with natural documents containing paraphrases, contradictions, repeated entities, and implicit multi-hop links while keeping retrieval and stopping answer-free.
acceptance_criteria: Report accuracy, ordered provenance, latency, and failure taxonomy on a frozen development/held-out split at 128 and 1k+ pages against no-page, BM25/embedding, and full-prefill or long-context controls.

title: Make model-written quotation carriers retrieval-robust
description: The frozen diverse suite missed two quotation-speaker cases because Qwen returned the quotation as an intermediate answer or changed punctuation/wording enough to revisit the citation page.
acceptance_criteria: Design an answer-free carrier normalization or semantic sidecar that preserves the who/where/what target, validate on disjoint quotation content without case-specific answer rules, and retain exact ordered-hop and latency controls.

title: Quantify original-position versus hot-slot semantics
description: Measure the effect of keeping cached blocks at their original positions versus remapping each candidate into the same effective hot slot near the query.
acceptance_criteria: Report correctness and selector-ranking results across randomized positions for both placement policies.

title: Test query-conditioned latent page capsules
description: For each reusable cold page, process the ordinary query prefix against that page, retain only a fixed-width tail of query-token KV as a latent query-conditioned capsule, discard raw page KV, concatenate all capsules, then refresh the query once over the compact capsule bank and decode normally.
acceptance_criteria: Compare capsule widths on direct and multi-hop tasks, including 12-page scale; report accuracy, online latency, compact cache size, and controls. Runtime must use no answer/relevance labels and generate no per-page text.
notes: Capsule widths 4, 8, and 16 all failed the representative two-hop task while full prefill succeeded. The decisive direct-fact sanity check also failed at width 8: full prefill returned mushroom pie, while the capsule condition said the information was absent. Query-tail KV capsules do not preserve usable page facts and are retired.
close_reason: Negative result: direct and multi-hop facts were lost by query-tail capsules.

title: Test query-attention cold-page shortlisting
notes:
Use query-prefix attention over concatenated independent cold KV as an answer-free page signal. Compare multiple predeclared attention aggregations, then reconstruct fixed top-K independent-KV and exact-text shortlist conditions against no-page and all-page full-prefill controls.
Completed Phase 8–11. Fixed all_query_mass covered all required top-4 pages on 5/12 holdout tasks and 5/6 full-prefill-capable tasks; exact replay answered 4/12 while independent KV composition answered 1/12. Packed V similarity scanned in ~6.3 ms at 128 pages but retrieval weakened at scale. Hybrid attention crossed full-attention latency near 64 pages; at 128 pages 42.05 ms vs 65.11 ms. Results and controls are in outputs/phase8 through phase11 and EXPERIMENT_LOG.md.
close_reason: Attention shortlisting, packed similarity, hybrid reranking, exact-replay controls, and 12–128 page scaling completed and documented.
